newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia set to tender for 50,000 tonnes of rice.
newsitem.headline: Colombia set to tender for 50,000 tonnes of rice.

text.p: Colombia is preparing to tender for up to 50,000 tonnes of rice to help cover a shortfall in domestic production, Agriculture Ministry sources said.
They said a formal announcement regarding the tender was expected to be made by Agriculture Minister Cecilia Lopez sometime next week.
The sources, who asked not to be identified by name, said it was not immediately clear what country Colombia would seek to buy the rice from.
